data.title: 爱丽丝 · 晨曦木屋的白被金发初醒
data.description: 卢利特郊外静谧小木屋的卧室内，初升的晨曦如融金般洒在洁白的大床上。爱丽丝侧卧在被褥间，一头璀璨的金色长发如波浪般铺满枕头。贴身的真丝睡袍领口微开，展现出如象牙般光洁的香肩与优美锁骨。这位曾立于世界顶点的骑士，此刻双眸泛着动人清光，向你伸出纤细的手掌，轻声呼唤着清晨的安宁。
data.action: lying on side amidst sunlit white bedding, silk nightdress loose at shoulder, golden hair spread across pillows, reaching hand out gently toward viewer, tender blissful gaze
data.location: rustic sun-drenched wooden cabin bedroom overlooking mountain forest
data.lighting: warm brilliant golden morning sunbeams pouring into the wooden bedroom
data.mood: peaceful eternal sanctuary, pure sacred morning devotion
data.promptProse: Lying leisurely on a sunlit wooden cabin bed, Alice reaches a gentle hand forward from beneath white sheets. Her flowing golden locks spread across the pillows as her bare shoulders catch the warm morning glow in tender silence.
data.animaCaption: Alice reaching out from a sunlit bed in a white silk nightgown with golden hair splayed.
